topics.label: Introduction and lecture overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic frames the lecture by introducing the hallmarks of cancer framework and outlining the session's learning objectives.

topics.label: Oncogenic growth signaling pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how mutations in cell surface receptors and intracellular signaling cascades drive sustained proliferation and survival.

topics.label: Differentiation block in tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics illustrate how arrests in terminal cellular differentiation contribute to leukemias and solid tumors.

topics.label: Evasion of apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes the molecular mechanisms and regulatory balance by which cancer cells avoid programmed cell death.

topics.label: Replicative immortality and senescence bypass
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how telomere dynamics and senescence bypass enable cellular immortality, alongside the stress responses that normally constrain replication.

topics.label: Metabolic reprogramming in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer cells alter their metabolism through aerobic glycolysis, pathway rewiring, and oncometabolite generation.

topics.label: Induction of tumor angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic addresses how expanding tumors stimulate new blood vessel growth to supply oxygen and nutrients.

topics.label: Mechanisms and dynamics of cancer metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the biological steps, clinical tracking, microenvironmental factors, and genomic features underlying metastatic dissemination.

topics.label: Conclusion and closing remarks
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with closing perspectives and reflections on the cancer hallmarks.
